page.overview:
Who is Fema Baab?

Fema Baab was a female human senator in the Senate of the Galactic Republic. Near the end of the Clone Wars, she was a steadfast supporter of Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine. Like Mee Deechi, Ask Aak, and Halle Burtoni, she advocated in favor of expanding the Grand Army of the Republic. Claiming to be patriotic to the Republic, she would question or threaten others who did not support the war. She wore a high-necked black dress.

In Revenge of the Sith, Fema Baab was played by Olive Levi.
